executive_summary: Maven build failed with 100 compilation errors across test files. Primary issues: (1) Missing service methods (getColumnStats, bulkUpdateColumnCounts, getTaskDetails, updateColumnCounts) in ColumnService and TaskService interfaces, (2) Type mismatches between enum types (TaskStatus, TaskPriority) and their nested counterparts in request DTOs, (3) String-to-Long conversion errors for ID fields. These errors indicate incomplete interface implementations and inconsistent type definitions between domain models and DTOs.

errors.message: 6 test methods fail: cannot find symbol method getColumnStats(String)
errors.root_cause: ColumnService interface is missing the getColumnStats(String columnId) method that ColumnControllerTest expects to exist.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add getColumnStats(String columnId) method signature to ColumnService interface and implement it in ColumnServiceImpl.

errors.message: 6 test methods fail: cannot find symbol method bulkUpdateColumnCounts(BulkUpdateColumnCountsRequest)
errors.root_cause: ColumnService interface is missing the bulkUpdateColumnCounts method that multiple test methods attempt to call.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add bulkUpdateColumnCounts(BulkUpdateColumnCountsRequest request) method to ColumnService interface and implement in ColumnServiceImpl.

errors.message: Multiple test methods fail: incompatible types - inference variable T has incompatible bounds (upper: Long, lower: String)
errors.root_cause: Test code is passing String values where Long is expected for task IDs, indicating a type mismatch in the API design or test setup.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskController and related DTOs to use Long consistently for task IDs instead of String, or update test code to use Long values.

errors.root_cause: TaskDetailsResponse DTO is missing the setColumnId setter method.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add setColumnId(String columnId) method to TaskDetailsResponse class or use Lombok @Setter annotation.

errors.message: 3 test methods fail: cannot find symbol method getTaskDetails(String)
errors.root_cause: TaskService interface is missing getTaskDetails(String taskId) method.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add getTaskDetails(String taskId) or getTaskDetails(Long taskId) method to TaskService interface and implement in TaskServiceImpl.

errors.message: Multiple test methods fail: TaskPriority cannot be converted to TaskCreateRequest.TaskPriority
errors.root_cause: TaskPriority enum exists in two places: as a standalone enum and as a nested enum in TaskCreateRequest, causing type incompatibility.
errors.fix_recommendation: Consolidate TaskPriority enum into a single shared location (e.g., com.myproject.models.dtos package) and remove the nested enum from TaskCreateRequest.

errors.message: Multiple test methods fail: TaskStatus cannot be converted to String
errors.root_cause: TaskResponse or Task entity expects status as String but test code provides TaskStatus enum.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update Task entity and TaskResponse DTO to use TaskStatus enum type instead of String for the status field.

errors.root_cause: TaskResponse DTO is missing setVersion method for optimistic locking version field.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add setVersion(long version) method to TaskResponse class or add @Setter annotation if using Lombok.

errors.message: 3 test methods fail: cannot find symbol method setLast(boolean)
errors.root_cause: PagedTaskResponse is missing setLast method for pagination metadata.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add setLast(boolean last) method to PagedTaskResponse or ensure proper Lombok annotations are present.

errors.message: 4 test methods fail: getUserTasks method cannot be applied - requires (Long,int,int) but found (Long,int,int,String)
errors.root_cause: Test code calls getUserTasks with 4 parameters but TaskService interface defines it with only 3 parameters.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskService.getUserTasks signature to accept status filter parameter: getUserTasks(Long userId, int page, int size, String status).

errors.root_cause: BulkTaskError class referenced in BulkTaskResponse does not exist.
errors.fix_recommendation: Create BulkTaskError class in com.myproject.models.dtos package with fields for error details (index, message, etc.).

errors.message: 4 test methods fail: cannot find symbol method updateColumnCounts(String,String)
errors.root_cause: ColumnService interface is missing updateColumnCounts method.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add updateColumnCounts(String columnId, String operation) method to ColumnService interface and implement in ColumnServiceImpl.
